svg.title: D1 solenoid former: drawing
svg.desc: Side section, end view and winding-groove detail of the PEEK or Delrin solenoid former with the 42-turn winding.
svg.text: D1 Solenoid former and winding: side section, end view, groove detail
All dimensions in mm. Side view drawn to scale (5 px per mm). Material: PEEK, Delrin (acetal) or printed PETG. No steel parts anywhere.
groove 140.4 long (42 turns), start and finish 70.2 from the mid-plane
dashed circle: winding radius a = 18.9 mm
return wires lie on top of the winding, 180° apart
One helical groove: 36 turns at 3.6 mm, then 3 turns at 1.8 mm at each end.
PEEK / Delrin tube Ø38 × Ø34 × 160. 42 turns of 0.50 mm enamelled copper in a helical groove. B = 3.39 mG per mA at the centre.
